11	`build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk`. After editing any Dart/Kotlin
12	in flux-app, `flutter install` silently installs a **stale cached APK**, so your
13	changes never reach the device.

15	**Why:** this wasted several debug cycles — "the fix isn't working" when the fix

18	**How to apply — to deploy a change to the Pixel 6 (`24221FDF6005YN`):**
19	1. Build from source: `flutter build apk --release` (or `flutter run --release` to build+install+attach). This actually recompiles.
20	2. Then install the fresh APK: `flutter install -d 24221FDF6005YN` **or** `adb -s 24221FDF6005YN install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk`.
21	3. **Verify** before testing: `stat -c '%y' build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk` must be newer than the edited sources. If a fix "doesn't work," check this first.
